purpose: Describe two opposite actions alternating or interacting.
keywords: Vます stem + つ + contrasting Vます stem + つ
I searched for the route, going back and forth.
He and I have a mutually supportive relationship.
The runners kept overtaking one another.
formation: Vます stem + つ + contrasting Vます stem + つ
restrictions: Common pairs include 行きつ戻りつ and 持ちつ持たれつ.
mistake: Use established contrasting pairs rather than arbitrary verb lists.
